purpose: Evaluate an OSINT pipeline against relationships explicitly supported by public sources while preserving legal uncertainty.
gold_edge_policy: An edge is gold only when a source explicitly supports the stated relationship. Inferred edges should be evaluated separately.
evaluation_targets: distinguishing criminal actors from payment channels and platforms
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not mark an accused person as convicted.
Do not convert an agency allegation into an adjudicated fact.
Do not label Nium India or WazirX as criminal organizations merely because they occur in the investigative graph.
Do not merge January and February 2025 aggregate financial figures into one total.
